sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:50 – 21:00)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Geared up and starting our patrol on Queen St heading down towards Commercial Bay as well as welfare check-ins with the stores.
Welfare sweep on lower Queen St, Freyberg and Chancery Square, Shortland St, Vulcan Lane and High St, no further issues. Store checks completed on:
Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, Vulcan Lane and Shortland St welfare sweeps complete. Lower Queen St welfare sweep concluded, no issues to report.
Customs St no issues to report. Starting welfare sweep on Commercial Bay, Commerce and Tyler St.
Welfare sweeps complete, Commercial Bay no issues found to report from public nor stores in the vicinity.
Tyler St, Commerce St complete, no issues to report, heading to Gore and Fort St. No further issues to report.
Gore St welfare check complete, no issues to report from:
Welfare check complete, no issues to report, continuing patrol to Fort St.
Fort St welfare check complete on:
No issues to report, welfare checks concluded. Heading through Queen St via Custom St towards Albert St.
Albert St no issues to report. Welfare check on Albert Mart, clear, no issues. Heading over to the Cathedral.
The Cathedral welfare sweep complete, no issues to report, heading over to Victoria St via Federal St.
Victoria St sweep clear, no issues to report, welfare checks on stores complete, heading down to Elliott St.
Elliott St / Darby sweep clear, no issues to report, welfare check on Elliott Stables clear, no issues to report, making our way to Aotea Sq.
Full sweep on Aotea Square completed, no issues to report, mild foot traffic in the area, coming back to Queen St for welfare checks.
Welfare checks on upper Queen St complete, no issues to report:
All clear, no issues. Moving up to Lorne St.
Lorne St sweep complete, no issues to report. Welfare check on Radisson Red, clear, no issues to report.
All sweeps and welfare checks complete, no issues nor calls to report, heading back onto Queen St to maintain security presence.
No calls or issues to report, heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone as the battery is low.
Guard standing down, debrief with handover guard complete, no issues to report. Guards will continue to report until 22:00.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ, guard clocking off, on standby for 2nd guard to arrive.
Check in Queen St McDonald's / Localito / Avachi / 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear, no issues.
Check in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, no issues.
Patrolling Lorne St, all clear, no issues.
Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone.
On standby at HQ charging Ops Phone.

Welfare check on McDonald's Queen, Timezone centre, Cha Cha Panda, 77 Convenience store, Cue Ball 8 and other businesses open in the area, no issues identified, heading up to Aotea Square to commence sweep.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing full sweep, a lot of footwork in the area, welfare checking the public in the process.
Full sweep Aotea Square completed, walking down Mayoral Drive heading to Elliott Street to welfare check Bar 101.
Arrived at Elliott Street, heading to Bar 101, showing security presence due to it being a crowded area.
Full sweep Elliott Street / Darby Street, welfare check Bar 101, all clear, no issues identified, patrolling up Victoria Street West.
Welfare check Victoria Street West and 77 Convenience store, all clear, no issues to report, patrolling down Federal St.
Full sweep Cathedral, Liston House, Federal St, welfare check Ace Karaoke bar, all clear, no issues to report, walking down Wyndham St to Queen Street.
Full sweep Wyndham Street, no issues identified, heading up Queen Street back to HQ to commence floor checks.
Welfare check Localito store, all clear, no issues to report, heading to HQ for floor checks.

Full sweep Fort Lane, Fort Street, Shortland Street, welfare check Shortland Mart, Evan's Kebabs, KFC, all clear, no issues to report, standing by at Sapphire Nightclub due to large numbers of male delinquents in the area.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, all clear, no issues to report, patrolling down to Britomart.
Full sweep Britomart centre, welfare check McDonald's and guard, not much footwork in the area so we will be continuing patrols.
Welfare check Kemuri guard and Reign n Pour, all clear, no further issues to report.

Arrived at Britomart, standing by showing security presence and welfare checking public service.
Stand down security presence at Britomart, no violent altercations seen, welfare check Britomart McDonald's, making our way to Bar 101.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, all clear, no further issues to report, making our way to Bar 101 through Queen Street.
Arrived at Bar 101, standing by showing presence, very large numbers of footwork in the area, standing by till closing.
Encountered 2 male individuals going off at each other in front of Bar 101, approached them and separated them away from each other, no further issues to report.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear, no issues to report, continuing patrols.
Sweep Darby St / Elliott St, all clear, no further issues, patrolling up Victoria Street.
Sweep Victoria Street West, welfare check 77 Convenience store, no further issues.
Full sweep Federal St, check in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, Liston House, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham St, all clear, no issues, heading down Queen Street to Britomart.
Welfare check Britomart McDonald's / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Completed check Fort St / Wilson carpark, all clear, no issues, patrolling up High Street to Freyberg for full sweep.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square, all clear, no issues.
Swept corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear, no issues, patrolling up to Aotea Square.
Full sweep Aotea Square, all clear, no issues to report, no footwork in the area, heading down Queen Street to welfare check on McDonald's.
Welfare check Queen St McDonald's, no issues to report, heading to HQ to commence break and standby for guard handover, responding to any calls that occur.
